# andashi

> A GrapheneOS phone declared in code: six profiles that work like network
> zones, each with its own apps, VPN, colour and wallpaper, a search-first
> launcher configured by one file per zone, applied over adb and verified by
> reading the device back.

andashi is a GrapheneOS distribution, not an Android ROM of its own. The zones
are Android users; what each one is, which apps live in it, what they may
reach and how it looks are declared in files and applied from a computer over
adb. No root, no privileged app, nothing agentic running on the phone.

## The model

- [Six zones](https://andashi.org/#zones): Home (trusted LAN, Tailscale, no Play services), Work (managed profile inside Home, RethinkDNS with lockdown), Cloud (DMZ), Gadgets (IoT VLAN, lockdown), Ops (management, stopped), Lab (guest, deliberately empty), Anon (Orbot, lockdown mandatory, links open in Tor Browser, password only)
- One VPN per Android profile is a platform limit, so the assignment is enforced by Android rather than by discipline
- Android runs three profiles at once: two zones stay stopped, two run on demand, and a stopped profile has its keys evicted

## The home screen (Andashi Home 0.7.0)

- A sharp zone wallpaper and a search bar at the bottom; search replaces the app drawer and moves its bar to the top, over a blurred wallpaper
- Chips under a query are recognisers only (call, message, email, contact, alarm, timer, calendar, website); no web, Google or YouTube search in any zone
- Contact search only in Home; Anon offers no website, message or contact chip
- On a Pixel Fold the favourites are a column on the right edge, and search on the inner screen uses two panes that never cross the hinge
- All screenshots and recordings are from emulators

## Declared in

- `config/profiles.json` — what a zone is: VPN, lockdown, runtime, unlock, whether Play services exist in it
- `config/apps.json` — which app lives in which zones, where its binary comes from, whether it may have INTERNET
- `config/settings.json`, `config/theming.json`, `config/features.json`
- `config/launcher/*.json` — generated per zone, pushed into the launcher, read back

## Limits, stated on the page

- It is not anonymity. Anon is a zone, not a cloak.
- Needs a GrapheneOS-supported Pixel, a computer with adb, and an unlocked bootloader.
- It builds on a wiped phone, it does not wipe one: the device-wide wipe belongs to the GrapheneOS install that comes first.
- Play services exist, sandboxed, in two zones with throwaway accounts, never in Home.
- What cannot be scripted is generated into a MANUAL.md to work through by hand.

## Repositories

- [andashi/provisioning](https://github.com/andashi/provisioning) — the declarative config and the provisioning chain
- [andashi/home](https://github.com/andashi/home) — the launcher, forked from Kvaesitso, GPL-3.0
